steps.name: Step 1 — Navigate to toolkit detail page
Step 2 — Open the Tool select on the Test-Tools empty state
Step 3 — Search for 'List branches' and select the tool
Step 3b — Verify the Test Settings panel is now shown
Step 4 — Click the Run Test button
Step 5 — Wait for the result to appear
Step 6 — Verify result contains branch names
